name: @w6w-apps/facebook-lead-ads
description: Read Facebook Lead Ads forms and their recent leads via the Facebook Graph API.

w6w.longDescription:
Facebook Lead Ads pulls lead-generation data out of Meta's ad platform — listing the lead forms configured on a Page, and reading the leads recently submitted through them, so a workflow can pick up new submissions without polling Facebook's own Ads Manager or Business Suite by hand.

It's a narrow, read-focused surface by design: two actions cover discovering which forms exist on a Page and fetching what came in through each one, which is exactly the shape a lead-routing workflow needs — get the new submissions as they arrive, then hand them off to a CRM, spreadsheet, or notification step elsewhere in the workflow rather than building that polling loop from scratch against the Graph API directly.
